exam.exam_name: Delhi Police Head Constable (Ministerial & AWO / TPO) Examination
exam.conducting_body: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) on behalf of Delhi Police
aliases: DP Head Constable Ministerial & Assistant Wireless Operator Exam

source_evidence.captured_wording: Candidates are required to capture live photograph using a webcam or mobile phone through the official MySSC app. Scanned photograph upload has been discontinued. Spectacles and caps are strictly prohibited during photo capture.
source_evidence.document_title: Notice of Examination for Head Constable (Ministerial) and Head Constable (AWO/TPO) in Delhi Police

requirements.requirement_name: Live Photograph (Real-time Webcam / MySSC App Capture)
requirements.content_instructions: Direct Digital Capture via Browser / MySSC App; Frontal webcam or mobile camera live capture; candidate positioned within on-screen bounding box; Live capture frame; Plain white or light plain background without patterns/shadows; Crucial SSC rule effective 2024: Pre-scanned photo uploads eliminated across all SSC exams; candidates must capture live face

JPG, JPEG; Width 4.0 cm x height 2.0 cm; file size 10 KB to 20 KB; 4.0 cm x 2.0 cm; Plain white paper; Running handwriting in black ink only; signatures in capital block letters will be rejected; Cropped horizontally without dark scanning shadows

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.
